### Interpret Without Delays with Study Preloading in Eden

As part of the viewer optimization and improved radiologist experience, we have implemented a **study preloading** tool. This feature allows studies to be selected directly from the Worklist for early download to the local server or viewer cache, achieving speeds up to 100 times faster and reducing opening times during reading.

‍

## What it is

A feature that enables proactive downloading of one or several studies from the Worklist without needing to open them immediately. This way, when the radiologist accesses the study, the images are already available locally, minimizing load latency, especially over remote connections or with complex studies (MRI, multi-series CT).

‍

## What it is for

- Reduces waiting times during reading.
- Optimizes the radiologist's session by preparing upcoming cases.
- Increases productivity on high-volume days.
- Facilitates the reading of heavy modalities, such as MRIs, mammograms, or multiphase studies.

‍

## Impact on workflow

Previously, each study was downloaded upon opening, causing delays. Now, the radiologist or technologist can preselect the studies to be read in the next session, ensuring instant availability when needed.

It is especially useful in hybrid environments (cloud + local) or in teleradiology, where download speed directly affects efficiency.

‍

## Changes to your PACS

- The Worklist preloads automatically upon logging into Eden PACS.
- New column to preload or remove the preload of all studies simultaneously.
- Option to manually select and preload studies in the Worklist, study lists, or custom lists.
- Visual indicators of download status:


  - Gray: Not preloaded.
  - Blue: In progress.
  - Green: Preloaded.
- The cache is managed automatically, freeing up space after studies are signed off or after a 24-hour period. The download will also be removed if the user logs out of their Eden account.

‍

## Implications for the user

Preloading offers a smoother experience, eliminating dead time and allowing the radiologist to focus on interpretation.

**Important**: Preloading is local to a single device; if you switch workstations, studies will need to be preloaded again. It does not alter study content, only makes it available earlier.

‍

## Usage recommendations

- Heavy studies or those with multiple series.
- Case lists for batch reading (e.g., shift planning).
- Scenarios with limited connectivity, where every second impacts productivity.

‍

### Maximize Your Workspace with the New Horizontal Bar

In Eden PACS, you own your space. Now you can choose how to view the new and improved horizontal series bar, designed to streamline your radiological interpretation.

‍

## Dynamic bar

The new series bar is located at the bottom of the DICOM viewer and remains hidden by default, creating more display space to view the full image without obstructions.

- To navigate the studies bar, simply move your cursor toward the study tab in the bottom bar.
- If you want to keep the bar visible, click the lock icon to pin it. This way, you can maintain visibility of all images.

‍

## Series, _all-in-one_

The new bar also includes a combined series that brings together all the images in the study so you can view them all at once, in the same place, with just a scroll.

‍

## Related studies

The series bar also lets you view all studies generated for the same patient\*, making it easier to compare previous studies for a more complete interpretation.

Simply navigate to the study you want to review and click the series you want to see. In the additional actions section (፧) you can:

- View and/or edit the study information
- Open the DICOM study in a new window
- View additional study files
- Download the study in DICOM format
- Download the study in PDF format

‍

## Identification errors

In addition, you will be able to identify studies with "identification errors." This feature detects when the patient information partially matches your current case but shows discrepancies such as phone number or ID. This way, you can correct capture errors without losing access to studies that could be relevant to the diagnosis.

Your interpretation, now more agile, precise and complete, all from Eden PACS. Discover the new series bar today in your DICOM viewer, or request it from your nearest representative.

‍

Faced with this reality, Eden RIS/PACS offers protections that far exceed those of on-premises systems, operating 100% cloud-native with an infrastructure backed by AWS:

- Being cloud-native, it updates automatically to comply with regulations and strengthen security systems without requiring external intervention.

In addition to its security and compliance advantages, Eden PACS's cloud-native infrastructure offers large-scale benefits for radiology institutions:

- [Reducing costs](https://edenmed.com/blog/costos-ocultos-radiologia-ris-pacs) in on-premises infrastructure, maintenance, and IT staff

- Providing immediate scalability to continue adapting to your institution's growth, staying up to date without requiring new hardware investments.

In a landscape where cyber threats are increasingly sophisticated and regulations more demanding, Eden PACS represents the logical evolution for radiology departments. It is not simply about adopting new technology, but about ensuring operational continuity and protecting what matters most: your patients' data and your institution's reputation.

### Reveal Every Last Detail with 3D Window Adjustments

In a 3D reconstruction, it is critical to visualize even the smallest detail to generate an accurate diagnosis. That's why you can now control the WW/WC settings in Eden PACS's advanced 3D.

With just a move of your cursor, you can adjust brightness and contrast values, highlighting critical elements of the reconstruction and eliminating visual noise.

‍

## To adjust WW/WC values in your advanced 3D

1. Enter the Eden PACS 3D viewer or select an MPR layout that includes a 3D viewport.
2. In the upper right corner, select the WW/WC tool.
3. In the 3D reconstruction, click and drag your cursor up or down to adjust the values manually.


1. To increase brightness, drag the cursor upward.
2. To increase contrast, drag the cursor downward.

Window adjustments are now available for 3D reconstructions in your Eden PACS. Try it today: take control of your 3D visualization for a clearer, more precise interpretation, down to the smallest detail.

### Signs It's Time to Change Your PACS System

In radiology, your tools dictate your workflow. That's why an outdated PACS system undermines productivity, patient care, and your lab's profitability. If you're facing any of the following issues today, it's time to consider an upgrade.

‍

## 1\. Slow image loading

A PACS that is slow to load images or access prior studies creates bottlenecks, affects the patient experience, and reduces responsiveness in emergencies. This not only reduces productivity at your institution, but also undermines your reliability and affects patient and referring physician retention.

With Eden PACS, that problem disappears. Its robust infrastructure, powered by AWS (Amazon Web Services), guarantees 99.9% _uptime_ and fast access to images stored in the cloud.

‍

## 2\. Lack of integration with other systems

If your PACS doesn't communicate efficiently with your RIS, HIS, or other health systems, information exchange becomes slow and error-prone. Especially in institutions with multiple sites, [interoperability](https://edenmed.com/blog/optimizar-eficiencia-radiologia-ia-digitalizacion) is key to an efficient workflow.

Eden PACS has more than one hundred integrations that allow it to work alongside other systems and prevent data loss. In addition, together with the Eden Management RIS module, it is possible to create a single workflow for your entire institution, ensuring communication between branches from a single platform.

‍

## 3\. High maintenance and support costs

PACS systems require manual updates, physical servers, and constant maintenance, which translates into [high operating costs](https://edenmed.com/blog/costos-ocultos-radiologia-ris-pacs). In addition, downtime caused by technical failures can affect productivity.

Eden PACS, being [cloud-native](https://edenmed.com/blog/ventajas-cambiar-ris-pacs-nube), offers operational agility with uninterrupted updates, with no need to invest in local infrastructure or maintenance. In addition, the Eden team is available 24 hours a day to provide technical support, eliminating wait times and the need for additional hires.

‍

## 4\. Limited experience for physicians and patients

If your physicians cannot [access studies](https://edenmed.com/blog/pacs-ideal-para-teleradiologia) outside the hospital, or your patients must pick up their results in physical form, your PACS is outdated. An updated system should offer secure remote access to speed up results delivery and ensure an outstanding experience.

Eden PACS goes further, sending digital results instantly via WhatsApp through the first 100% mobile DICOM viewer. This way, both patients and referring physicians will have in hand high-quality medical images, diagnostic reports, and a complete radiology history, without paper, USB drives, or long wait times.

‍

Upgrading your PACS is a critical decision for improving operational efficiency and quality of service at your radiology institution. Eden PACS offers a scalable, cloud-native solution with full interoperability to transform the management of medical images.

3. Click on the study to open it in your DICOM viewer. The hanging protocol **will activate automatically.**

### How to Choose the Ideal PACS for Teleradiology

Teleradiology has revolutionized healthcare by enabling remote interpretation of imaging studies. To ensure accurate diagnoses and an agile workflow, it is essential to have a PACS system that optimizes the management of medical images in remote settings. Below, we explain the key aspects to consider when choosing the ideal PACS for teleradiology.

‍

## Fast, real-time accessible PACS

A PACS designed for teleradiology must ensure fast loading and visualization of studies, even with variable internet connections. By accessing high-quality images without delays, specialists can streamline the diagnostic process and deliver results in less time.

Eden PACS features a [cloud-native](https://edenmed.com/blog/transformando-la-atencion-medica-mediante-la-gestion-en-la-nube) infrastructure, ensuring its [accessibility](https://edenmed.com/blog/ventajas-cambiar-ris-pacs-nube) anytime and from anywhere. It also offers the first 100% mobile DICOM viewer, enabling excellent diagnoses even from a mobile phone.

‍

## Security and HIPAA compliance

Remote transmission of medical images requires high security standards. A suitable PACS must comply with international regulations such as HIPAA, ensuring data encryption, multi-factor authentication, and audit logs to prevent unauthorized access.

At Eden, we ensure excellent [cybersecurity](https://edenmed.com/blog/reglas-ciberseguridad-datos-pacs-ris) with additional certifications such as ISO 27001 for data protection, in addition to complying with regional regulations in 18 countries across Latin America.

‍

## Interoperable RIS/PACS with system integrations

To maximize efficiency, your PACS system must be able to communicate with RIS (Radiology Information System), HIS (Hospital Information System), or electronic health record (EHR) platforms used in your radiology department. Seamless interoperability enables automatic data transfer and avoids duplication of administrative processes.

Eden offers a complete ecosystem that includes RIS, PACS, results delivery, and patient clinical history under a single license. This creates efficient workflows, free of friction or redundancy, even remotely. Additionally, our systems are interoperable and offer hundreds of integrations to adapt to your institution's needs.

‍

## DICOM viewer with high-specialty tools

Finally, to deliver excellent diagnoses, you must ensure that your [DICOM viewer](https://edenmed.com/blog/visor-dicom-impacto-precision-diagnostico-radiologia) offers tools such as [3D reconstruction](https://edenmed.com/blog/como-aprovechar-la-herramienta-de-reconstruccion-3d) and MPR. These features enhance diagnostic accuracy and optimize specialists' analysis time.

With Eden PACS, your radiologists also have access to advanced tools such as PET-CT, blood vessel reconstruction, and specialized suites for orthopedics and mammography. This allows you to expand your service catalog, offering high-specialty diagnoses on a 100% remote basis.

‍

## Conclusion

Choosing the right PACS for teleradiology is essential to ensure fast, secure remote diagnoses. Factors such as loading speed, security, compatibility, interoperability, and advanced tools should be top priorities when selecting the system.

With Eden PACS, you have at your disposal a cloud-native ecosystem, designed to deliver diagnostic excellence from anywhere. Discover its potential today. [Schedule your demo.](http://edenmed.com/agenda-demo)

### AI in Medical Imaging Diagnosis: What You Should Know

AI applied to radiology is already raising diagnostic accuracy and speeding up study interpretation times at thousands of healthcare institutions. However, its implementation must be strategic to ensure effectiveness and safety in clinical practice.

## Automation and diagnostic accuracy with AI

AI in radiology makes it possible to eliminate repetitive tasks such as analyzing plain radiographs and writing radiology reports, reducing specialists' workload and minimizing errors.
